required_fixes.text: Call the expression in lines 93-95 the cut objective, not the completed family deficiency. Write d(E(R))=f(R)+kappa(R\N(E(R)))>=f(R). If R=N(F), completion has the same recipient set and d(E(R))>=d(F). These two observations prove (3).

Replace “satisfying all of (4)-(9)” with “satisfying (4)-(8), and (9) when its completed graph H is proper; when H=G, epsilon=1+h.” The condition concerns the minimal-family completion H, not merely the maximal maximizing cut H*.
